name: Kyozou Teien ~Shoujo no Chiru Basho~
original_name: 虚像庭園 ～少女の散る場所～
source:
A guy got lost and ran out of gas. He ended up at a mansion where a girl and her maid lives. He is invited to stay until their guardian's monthly visit. When she arrived, he found out that this girl is the one that his brother died to save from a car accident. Thinking that she likes him only as his brother, he decided to make them into pets. Will he live happy or master?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
一个人迷路了，汽油用完了。他最终来到了一座宅邸，里面住着一个女孩和她的女仆。他被邀请留下来直到他们的监护人每月来访。当她到达时，他发现这个女孩就是他哥哥在一场车祸中为救而死的女孩。他认为她只是把他当作弟弟一样喜欢，于是决定把它们养成宠物。他会幸福地生活还是成为主人？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]李家欢乐屋[/url]]
